efficientad_wacv_2024.locator: §3.1, page 3: each PDN output neuron has a 33×33-pixel receptive field; §3.3, page 5: the autoencoder encodes the complete image and its map is combined with the local map.

local_pdn_derivation.derivation: Receptive-field recurrence r'=r+(k-1)j and jump recurrence j'=j*s yield r=33 and j=4. For padding=False, the listed layers map 256 to 56 cells; pad_maps=True adds four cells on every edge before bilinear interpolation.

candidate_tiling_geometry.rationale: The local candidate uses half of the 33-pixel PDN receptive field as a border and twice that border as overlap. It is not a seam-equivalence guarantee.

autoencoder_limitation.rationale: The autoencoder branch is evaluated on each whole tile and is combined with the local map, so any overlap chosen from the local PDN alone cannot prove identical seams.

finalization_gate.selection_rule: Choose the final border only from an empirical plateau across tile origins and probes on frozen normal validation data.
